note: The death match is a development benchmark (rulings §5.8, §5.20, §5.22). Every arm runs the same tasks on the same model and is scored by deathmatch.py.

arms.prompt: Review the code in this folder for bugs. For each bug give the file:line, what is wrong, and a concrete input or sequence that makes it fail. Change no files.

/code-review:code-review the change on this branch. There is no GitHub pull request: the change is `git diff main...HEAD` in this folder, so read it with git instead of gh, and print your final review comment here instead of posting it. Change no files.
arms.note: Anthropic's official code-review plugin (code-review-anthropics in the Anthropic directory). It reviews GitHub pull requests; here the task is committed as a branch over an empty base, and the prompt says to read the local diff and print the comment.
Claude Code's built-in /code-review command (no plugin). It reviews the working folder and replies with a JSON list of findings, which deathmatch.py reads like any other arm's.

Only with local rules in $SEMGREP_RULES, never the registry (it would send data out). The 24 Oct 2026 run used Semgrep's own published javascript/ and html/ rules (semgrep/semgrep-rules, Semgrep Rules License v1.0), kept outside this repository.
